sources.title: SAMPLE — Balancing water formation
sources.subject: Physical Sciences
sources.text: To balance hydrogen reacting with oxygen to form water, write 2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O. There are four hydrogen atoms and two oxygen atoms on each side. Change coefficients, not subscripts: changing a subscript changes the identity of a substance. A coefficient multiplies the whole formula.
